players.detail: Head coach Todd Bowles said Monday that the Buccaneers "will try and lessen the load" on Irving following their Week 10 bye, Rick Stroud of the Tampa Bay Times reports.

players.name: Jalen McMillan
players.detail: Head coach Todd Bowles suggested Monday that McMillan (knee) isn't likely to immediately return to action following the Buccaneers' Week 10 bye, Rick Stroud of the Tampa Bay Times reports.

players.name: Chris Godwin Jr.
players.detail: Godwin caught two of three targets for 16 yards and added a 12-yard rush during Sunday night's 27-24 loss to the Bears.

players.name: Kenny Gainwell
players.detail: Gainwell rushed five times for 16 yards and caught all three of his targets for 60 yards in Sunday's 27-24 loss to the Bears.

players.name: Emeka Egbuka
players.detail: Egbuka (foot) caught three of five targets for 38 yards and added a one-yard run in Sunday's 27-24 loss to the Bears.

players.name: Chimere Dike
players.detail: Dike caught two passes for 16 yards on three targets in Sunday's 40-23 loss to the Jaguars. He added five rushing yards on one attempt.

players.name: Daniel Bellinger
players.detail: Bellinger caught two of three targets for six yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 40-23 loss to the Jaguars.

players.name: Joey Slye
players.detail: Slye made all three of his field-goal attempts and both of his extra-point tries during the Titans' 40-23 loss to the Jaguars on Sunday. He also logged a tackle and forced a fumble.

players.name: Xavier Restrepo
players.detail: Restrepo reverted to the Titans' practice squad Monday, per the NFL's transaction log.

players.name: Calvin Ridley
players.detail: Ridley played four offensive snaps and didn't show up on the box score otherwise during the Titans' 40-23 loss to the Jaguars on Sunday.

players.name: Carnell Tate
players.detail: Titans head coach Robert Saleh said Monday that he's hopeful that Tate (shoulder) will return to action in Week 11 versus the Cowboys, Jim Wyatt of the team's official site reports.

players.name: Gunnar Helm
players.detail: Helm caught all four of his targets for 23 yards in Sunday's 40-23 loss to the Jaguars.

players.name: Tyjae Spears
players.detail: Spears rushed four times for 28 yards in Sunday's 40-23 loss to the Jaguars. He turned one catch into zero yards on one target.

players.name: Elic Ayomanor
players.detail: Ayomanor caught five of 10 targets for 79 yards in Sunday's 40-23 loss to the Jaguars.

players.name: Tony Pollard
players.detail: Pollard carried the ball nine times for 33 yards and caught eight of nine targets for 66 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 40-23 loss to the Jaguars.

players.name: Cam Ward
players.detail: Ward completed 28 of 39 passes for 231 yards and two touchdowns with one interception in Sunday's 40-23 loss to the Jaguars.

players.name: Wan'Dale Robinson
players.detail: Robinson is questionable to return to Sunday's game against the Jaguars due to an ankle injury.

players.name: Jacory Croskey-Merritt
players.detail: The Commanders designated Croskey-Merritt (groin) for return from injured reserve Tuesday.

players.name: Colson Yankoff
players.detail: questionable

players.name: Drew Stevens
players.detail: Stevens made his only field-goal attempt and was successful on all three of his extra-point tries in Thursday's 24-21 win over the Giants.

players.name: Ben Sinnott
players.detail: Sinnott caught all four of his targets for 42 yards and a touchdown Thursday in a 24-21 victory against the Giants.

players.name: Treylon Burks
players.detail: Burks caught two of three targets for 27 yards Thursday in a 24-21 win over the Giants.

players.name: Antonio Williams
players.detail: Williams secured both targets for 42 yards and a touchdown in the Commanders' 24-21 win over the Giants on Thursday.

players.name: Austin Ekeler
players.detail: Ekeler rushed nine times for 26 yards and brought in all four targets for 26 yards in the Commanders' 24-21 win over the Giants on Thursday.

players.name: Rachaad White
players.detail: White rushed 11 times for 47 yards and brought in one of two targets for five yards in the Commanders' 24-21 win over the Giants on Thursday.

players.name: Stefon Diggs
players.detail: Diggs secured six of 10 targets for 83 yards and a touchdown in the Commanders' 24-21 win over the Giants on Thursday.

players.name: Jayden Daniels
players.detail: Daniels completed 23 of 33 passes for 249 yards with three touchdowns and two interceptions and rushed 11 times for 28 yards in the Commanders' 24-21 win over the Giants on Thursday.

players.name: Chig Okonkwo
players.detail: Okonkwo (back) returned to Thursday's eventual 24-21 win at the Giants, finishing with four catches (on eight targets) for 24 yards.

players.name: Van Jefferson
players.detail: Jefferson caught five of seven targets for 58 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 20-13 loss to the Rams.
